INSERT INTO block_manifest_state (
            consensus_epoch,
            host_chain_id,
            block_number,
            block_hash,
            parent_block_hash,
            publication_cadence,
            block_content_digest,
            block_handle_count,
            sealed_by_schema
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 0, public.stack_schema())
        ON CONFLICT (consensus_epoch, host_chain_id, block_hash) DO NOTHING
